org_sub: TRN · Enhanced Tabular Recipe Notation · https://trn.f00.sh
subject: TRN operator standard operating procedure (run, convert, deploy, release)
opening: Bottom line: TRN converts recipes into Enhanced Tabular Recipe Notation (eTRN). Operators run the Streamlit app locally, use or deploy the Cloudflare Pages site, and ship SemVer releases with the full documentation pack.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This memorandum is the living operator handbook for TRN. It states how to run the converter, extract recipes, deploy the product site, and ship a versioned release.

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body: This SOP covers product operations for TRN. It does not replace the README, man page, or the live site at https://trn.f00.sh.
items: release ship flow and docs pack

steps.text: Keep the converter simple: URL or paste in, eTRN table and JSON out.
Rule-based path must work without network keys. LLM path is optional.
Never commit API keys or secrets. Users paste keys in session only.
Cloudflare Pages is the delivery plane for the public site. GitHub is source and release history only.
Every SemVer release updates CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README, man, SOP PDF, and this-version release memo PDF.

sections.heading: 5. Day-to-day operator flow
sections.body: Use this path for local conversion and quality checks.

steps.text: Clone github.com/f00-sh/trn and enter the repository root.
Create a virtual environment and install requirements.txt.
Run: streamlit run app.py
Paste a recipe with Ingredients and Instructions headers. Click Convert.
Confirm Markdown table, eTRN JSON download, and printable view.
Optional: enable LLM path with an xAI or OpenAI-compatible key for denser stage labels.

figure.title: Sample eTRN process matrix
figure.caption: Ingredient rows × chronological stage columns. Empty cells mean idle. Dense phosphor table style matches the product site.

sections.heading: 6. Extraction rules
sections.body: Prefer structured sources. Fail soft with clear messages.
items: Edge site: POST /api/scrape then client parse
If blocked (HTTP 401/403/429): instruct operator to paste text
Paste parser: look for Ingredients and Instructions headers

steps.text: Ensure site/ and functions/ are correct on main.
Deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=f00-trn --branch=main
Confirm custom domain trn.f00.sh resolves and shows the converter.
Smoke: paste a short recipe, convert, download JSON.
Smoke: URL scrape against a JSON-LD recipe page when network allows.

sections.heading: 8. Release ship flow
sections.body: Ship only after convert smoke and docs pack are complete.

steps.text: Bump version surfaces: CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README/site version strings, man page if needed.
Update docs/sop-trn-ops.json and re-render SOP PDF.
Write docs/releases/vX.Y.Z-memo.json for this version only; render memo PDF.
Commit, tag vX.Y.Z, push main and tags.
Create GitHub Release; attach SOP PDF, memo PDF, file_id.diz.
Deploy Pages if site changed; update f00 hub product card when copy or first ship requires it.

rows: Paste full recipe text; do not retry aggressively
Require Ingredients and Instructions headers in paste
Fall back to rule-based path; check base_url and model
Check CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, project name f00-trn, wrangler login
Confirm Pages custom domain + f00.sh zone CNAME
